rotp_spin.configuration.title: Spin Configuration
rotp_spin.configuration.max.tooltip: Most Spin energy a player can hold. A higher value lets a user keep fighting longer before running dry.
rotp_spin.configuration.regenPerTick.too: Spin energy restored every tick (20 ticks = 1 second). Higher values refill the bar faster.
rotp_spin.configuration.strength.tooltip: Strength of the Spin leap (Sneak + Jump on the ground), learned with lesson 1. A higher value jumps farther. For comparison, RotP's Hamon leap is 1.4.
rotp_spin.configuration.cooldownTicks.to: How long this ability stays on cooldown after use, in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). 0 means no cooldown. For the steel ball, it is the item cooldown after a throw.
rotp_spin.configuration.energyCost.toolt: Spin energy consumed each time the technique is used.
rotp_spin.configuration.ignoreSlowness.t: On: the leap is driven by will, not by the legs, so Slowness does not weaken it (speed boosts still help). Off: Slowness weakens the leap.
rotp_spin.configuration.fallDistanceRedu: Fall distance, in blocks, that a Spin user is not charged for when landing. It replaces RotP's generic leap bonus (about 19 blocks), because Spin does not make the body superhuman. 0 forgives nothing.
rotp_spin.configuration.windupTicks.tool: Ticks of holding before the spinning body becomes rigid. A higher value means a longer wait before the brace protects you.
rotp_spin.configuration.energyPerTick.to: Spin energy consumed every tick while the ability is held or running (20 ticks = 1 second).
Share of the damage from projectiles, explosions and melee hits that the rigid body absorbs (0.7 = 70%). Capped at 0.95: temporary toughness, not invulnerability.
rotp_spin.configuration.energyPerAbsorbe: Spin energy spent for each point of damage absorbed. With too little energy, only part of the blow is absorbed.
rotp_spin.configuration.attackerKnockbac: Knockback strength a melee attacker receives when the brace absorbs their blow: the energy of the blow is passed back to them. 0 disables.
rotp_spin.configuration.noOwnKnockback.t: On: the rigid body is not knocked back while the stance is held. Off: the user is pushed back as usual.
rotp_spin.configuration.slownessAmplifie: Amplifier of the Slowness effect the user gets while the stance or charge lasts (0 = Slowness I). -1 disables it.
rotp_spin.configuration.turnRate.tooltip: How sharply the ball turns toward the aim point each tick (0 = no turn, 1 = instant). Higher values steer more tightly.
rotp_spin.configuration.minSpeed.tooltip: A steered ball keeps at least this speed, in blocks per tick, so its rotation does not fade while it is held.
rotp_spin.configuration.aimDistance.tool: The ball flies toward the point this many blocks ahead along the user's look.
rotp_spin.configuration.searchRange.tool: Only the user's own spinning ball within this distance can be steered.
rotp_spin.configuration.reach.tooltip: Maximum distance to the target, in blocks. For Block Spin Throw, how far the aimed block may be.
rotp_spin.configuration.stunTicks.toolti: How long the target's muscles stay seized (a RotP stun), in ticks. 20 ticks = 1 second.
rotp_spin.configuration.forcedAction.too: On: before the muscles seize, the hijacked mob makes one forced move: a ranged mob shoots, a melee mob strikes the nearest other creature (never the Spin user). Off: it just freezes.
rotp_spin.configuration.forcedActionRang: How far from the hijacked mob, in blocks, a creature can be to become the target of its forced move.
rotp_spin.configuration.disarmPlayers.to: On: a hijacked player's hand opens and the main hand item is dropped. Off: players keep their items.
rotp_spin.configuration.damage.tooltip: Damage dealt, in health points (2 = one heart). A thrown item or block uses it as a base that its launch speed multiplies, like an arrow.
rotp_spin.configuration.knockback.toolti: Knockback strength: the energy of the rotation throws the touched body away from the user (vanilla knockback units; a sword hit is 0.4).
rotp_spin.configuration.lift.tooltip: The target is lifted to at least this vertical speed, in blocks per tick. 0 = no lift.
rotp_spin.configuration.chippedMultiplie: A chipped (imperfect) ball gives only this share of the strike's damage, knockback and lift.
rotp_spin.configuration.enabled.tooltip: Switches this feature on or off; the group heading says which. Off disables it completely (for Lessons, off unlocks every technique at once). Compatibility switches do nothing when the other mod is not installed.
rotp_spin.configuration.maxChargeTicks.t: Ticks of holding to reach the full charge. A higher value means a slower charge.
rotp_spin.configuration.maxVelocityMulti: Throw speed multiplier at full charge (spinning throw only; it grows linearly with the charge).
rotp_spin.configuration.maxDamageMultipl: Base damage multiplier at full charge, on top of the speed gain (spinning throw only).
rotp_spin.configuration.chippedMaxCharge: Highest charge share a chipped (imperfect) ball can take: it cannot hold the higher rotation.
rotp_spin.configuration.velocity.tooltip: Launch velocity, in blocks per tick. Higher values fly faster and hit harder.
Lesson 2, "Use your muscles", is learned after this many hits on creatures with a spinning steel ball.
rotp_spin.configuration.lesson3Hijacks.t: Lesson 3, "Believe in the rotation", is learned after this many successful Muscle Hijacks.
rotp_spin.configuration.lesson4GoldenHit: Lesson 4, "Pay tribute. Spin the bullets in the golden ratio", is learned after this many hits on creatures with a spinning steel ball at lesson 3.
rotp_spin.configuration.lesson5GoldenHit: Lesson 5, "The shortest route is the detour" (Super Spin), is learned after this many spinning ball hits in total at lesson 4 or above (cumulative with the lesson 4 counter).
rotp_spin.configuration.multiplier4.tool: Golden Spin (lesson 4): damage multiplier of a spinning steel ball while calibrated (in a living biome, in falling snow, or with a calibration buckle in the inventory).
rotp_spin.configuration.multiplier5.tool: Super Spin (lesson 5): damage multiplier of a spinning steel ball, anywhere, with no calibration needed.
rotp_spin.configuration.chippedRetention: Share (0 to 1) of the bonus that a chipped, imperfect ball keeps: for Golden Spin, of the multiplier above x1; for Senescence Touch, of its damage and aging duration. 1 means no penalty.
rotp_spin.configuration.horseGallopSpeed: A ridden horse moving at least this fast (blocks per tick, horizontal, smoothed over a few ticks) gives Super Spin without calibration, from lesson 4.
rotp_spin.configuration.deadBiomeCategor: Biome categories with no natural golden-ratio markers (frozen strait, desert, void): Golden Spin needs the calibration buckle there. One name per entry: NETHER, THEEND, OCEAN, SAVANNA, MESA, JUNGLE, TAIGA, FOREST, RIVER, BEACH, PLAINS, ICY, DESERT, SWAMP, MUSHROOM, EXTREME_HILLS, UNDERGROUND, NONE.
rotp_spin.configuration.snowfallCalibrat: On: falling snow on the thrower (open sky, snowy weather) is a golden-ratio reference even in a dead biome. Off: snow does not calibrate Golden Spin.
rotp_spin.configuration.holdTicks.toolti: Ticks of holding, with empty hands, needed to frame the golden rectangle. A hit breaks the framing.
rotp_spin.configuration.durationTicks.to: How long the framed rectangle calibrates Golden Spin, in ticks, anywhere including dead biomes. 600 ticks = 30 seconds.
rotp_spin.configuration.multiplier.toolt: Damage multiplier of a spinning steel ball under Super Spin (natural gallop or the lesson 5 detour). It never lowers the multiplier the user already has.
rotp_spin.configuration.gallopTicks.tool: Ticks of gallop (see Gallop speed) before the horse's energy flows into the throw. A crash into an obstacle, or a hit on the horse or the rider, resets it; fall damage from rough ground does not.
rotp_spin.configuration.graceTicks.toolt: The horse may drop below gallop speed for this many ticks in a row (a hill, a turn, a jump, a lag spike) without losing the build-up. It does not grow meanwhile.
rotp_spin.configuration.crashStopFractio: A collision counts as a crash only if the horse's speed in that tick falls below this share of its gallop speed (a real stop against an obstacle). Sliding along a wall or stepping up a block is not a crash. 0 disables crashes.
rotp_spin.configuration.horseMinHealth.t: The horse must be healthy: its health share must be at least this.
rotp_spin.configuration.detourEnabled.to: Lesson 5, "The shortest route is the detour": a spinning ball hitting your own horse makes it kick you and hands over Super Spin. A chipped ball fails. Off: Super Spin cannot be gained this way.
rotp_spin.configuration.detourRange.tool: The user must be this close to the horse, in blocks, to be kicked.
rotp_spin.configuration.detourDurationTi: How long the energy of the kick stays in the user, in ticks. 200 ticks = 10 seconds.
rotp_spin.configuration.detourKickDamage: Damage the hoof kick deals to the user, in health points (2 = one heart).
rotp_spin.configuration.intervalTicks.to: Health is restored once per this many ticks of holding. A higher value heals more slowly.
rotp_spin.configuration.amount.tooltip: Health restored per interval (2 = one heart).
rotp_spin.configuration.targetReach.tool: While Sneak is held, the entity under the crosshair within this distance is treated instead of the user.
rotp_spin.configuration.curesHarmfulEffe: On: each interval also removes poison, wither and RotP bleeding. Off: the treatment only restores health.
"X-ray": water (a pool or a filled cauldron) within this many blocks of the patient shows the ripples of the rotation: the healer sees the hidden ailments and the treatment is more precise. 0 disables.
rotp_spin.configuration.xrayAmountMultip: Health restored per interval is multiplied by this while the water shows the ripples.
rotp_spin.configuration.spinCost.tooltip: Spin energy consumed by a throw with Spin. Without enough energy the ball is thrown plainly: no return, lower damage.
rotp_spin.configuration.spinDamage.toolt: Base damage of a spinning ball; it is multiplied by the ball's velocity, like an arrow.
rotp_spin.configuration.plainDamage.tool: Base damage of a ball thrown without Spin.
rotp_spin.configuration.spinVelocity.too: Launch velocity of a spinning ball, in blocks per tick.
rotp_spin.configuration.plainVelocity.to: Launch velocity of a ball thrown without Spin, in blocks per tick.
rotp_spin.configuration.inaccuracy.toolt: How much throws scatter, with the same meaning as for vanilla arrows. 0 is perfectly accurate; higher values spread the ball more.
rotp_spin.configuration.returnAfterTicks: A spinning ball starts returning to the thrower after this many ticks of flight (or earlier, on a hit).
rotp_spin.configuration.maxReturnTicks.t: If the ball has not reached the thrower within this many ticks of returning, it loses its rotation and drops.
rotp_spin.configuration.returnAccelerati: How strongly a returning ball is pulled toward the thrower each tick. Higher values bring it back faster.
rotp_spin.configuration.damagedChanceOnB: Chance (0 to 1) that the ball becomes damaged when it hits a block. A damaged ball is imperfect and weaker.
rotp_spin.configuration.damagedDamageMul: Damage multiplier of a damaged (imperfect) ball.
rotp_spin.configuration.ricochetMaxBounc: A spinning ball ricochets off blocks this many times before it starts returning. 0 = no ricochet.
rotp_spin.configuration.ricochetSpeedRet: Share of its speed the ball keeps after a ricochet (0.7 = 70%).
rotp_spin.configuration.ricochetMinSpeed: If the ball's speed after a ricochet is below this, in blocks per tick, it stops bouncing and returns.
rotp_spin.configuration.repairMaterial.t: Item ID used with a damaged steel ball in an anvil (one per ball) to restore the perfect sphere, for example minecraft:iron_ingot.
Experience levels the anvil repair costs. 0 makes it free.
rotp_spin.configuration.barkStripping.to: On: a spinning steel ball strips the bark off a log it hits, like an axe. Needs the thrower's permission to use items at that spot.
rotp_spin.configuration.barkMinSpeed.too: Minimum ball speed, in blocks per tick, to strip bark.
rotp_spin.configuration.barkSpeedRetenti: Share of speed the ball keeps after stripping bark (friction against the trunk).
rotp_spin.configuration.bulletCutting.to: On: a spinning steel ball cuts bullets (iron nuggets) out of an iron block it hits, once per flight. Needs the thrower's permission to use items at that spot.
rotp_spin.configuration.bulletMinSpeed.t: Minimum ball speed, in blocks per tick, to cut bullets in metal.
rotp_spin.configuration.bulletsPerCut.to: Iron nuggets cut out per hit.
rotp_spin.configuration.bulletNuggetsPer: Nuggets an iron block is worth: the block is used up with a chance of "Nuggets per cut" divided by this, so carving never yields more iron than crafting.
rotp_spin.configuration.bulletSpeedReten: Share of speed the ball keeps after cutting the metal.
rotp_spin.configuration.maxTicks.tooltip: Longest pull, in ticks; then the rope lets go and the ball returns.
rotp_spin.configuration.pullStrength.too: Velocity added to the thrower toward the anchor each tick, in blocks per tick. Higher values pull harder.
rotp_spin.configuration.maxSpeed.tooltip: Speed cap of the pulled thrower, in blocks per tick.
The rope lets go when the thrower is this close to the anchor, in blocks.
rotp_spin.configuration.maxLength.toolti: The ball anchors only this close to the thrower, in blocks; farther away it just returns.
rotp_spin.configuration.capacity.tooltip: How many steel balls the holster holds (Gyro's belt has two side holsters).
rotp_spin.configuration.touchDamage.tool: Direct, armor-piercing damage dealt in the touched zone.
rotp_spin.configuration.touchRange.toolt: Radius around the Stand, in blocks, in which everything ages.
rotp_spin.configuration.touchStamina.too: Stamina the Stand spends on Senescence Touch.
rotp_spin.configuration.senescenceDurati: How long the aging lasts after a touch, in ticks. 20 ticks = 1 second.
rotp_spin.configuration.senescenceInterv: Aging wounds the victim once per this many ticks.
rotp_spin.configuration.senescenceDamage: Aging damage per interval; it ignores armor.
rotp_spin.configuration.spinDamageMultip: While Ball Breaker is summoned and Golden Spin is calibrated, the damage multiplier of the thrower's spinning steel balls (the visualization amplifies the Spin itself).
rotp_spin.configuration.maxStacks.toolti: Every new touch (or Golden throw under Ball Breaker) deepens senescence by one level, up to this many levels.
rotp_spin.configuration.standStaminaDrai: Stand stamina that a Stand user loses per senescence level on each touch. A touch on a Stand's figure ages its user. 0 disables.
rotp_spin.configuration.maxHealthPerStac: Aged body: maximum health lost per senescence level while it lasts. Lost health is not given back when it ends. 0 disables.
rotp_spin.configuration.speedPerStack.to: Aged body: share of movement speed lost per senescence level (0.1 = 10%).
rotp_spin.configuration.attackPerStack.t: Aged body: attack damage lost per senescence level.
rotp_spin.configuration.minLesson.toolti: Lowest Spin lesson the user must have reached for this to work (lessons go from 1 to 5; where 0 is allowed, it means any Spin user).
rotp_spin.configuration.summonOnManifest: On: the Stand appears at once with the throw that manifested it, as in the manga. Off: it is not summoned automatically.
rotp_spin.configuration.sparksPerTick.to: Energy specks around the body each tick, scaled by the summon fade-in. 0 draws none.
rotp_spin.configuration.radius.tooltip: Radius, in blocks, of the area this feature works in: the cloud around the body for the aura, or the distance around the thrower within which projectiles count as sources for resonance.
rotp_spin.configuration.arcChance.toolti: Chance (0 to 1) per tick of a discharge arc across the cloud.
rotp_spin.configuration.arcSegments.tool: Number of joints in one discharge arc. More joints make it look more jagged.
rotp_spin.configuration.arcJitter.toolti: How far, in blocks, an arc joint may zigzag off the straight line.
rotp_spin.configuration.satellites.toolt: How many satellite balls a Wrecking Ball carries (canon: 14; the model always shows 14 sockets).
rotp_spin.configuration.releaseAfterTick: Ticks of flight before the satellites fly out.
Base damage of one satellite (like an arrow, multiplied by its velocity).
rotp_spin.configuration.satelliteSpeed.t: Launch velocity of a satellite, in blocks per tick.
rotp_spin.configuration.satelliteRange.t: The satellites aim at the nearest living victim within this distance, in blocks; with none near, they fan out.
rotp_spin.configuration.satelliteLifetim: Ticks before a spent satellite discards itself.
Even a miss raises a shockwave: living victims within this radius, in blocks, are wounded and disoriented.
Base damage of the shockwave raised by a miss.
rotp_spin.configuration.neglectDurationT: How long the shockwave's hemispatial neglect lasts, in ticks: victims ignore their left side.
rotp_spin.configuration.neglectBlocksRet: On: a neglected mob cannot pick a new target on its left side either (canon: this is how Spin users hid themselves and allies). Off: it can still pick targets on its left.
rotp_spin.configuration.neglectVeerDegre: A neglected rider's horse keeps drifting to the right by this many degrees per tick (canon: horses turned right). 0 disables.
rotp_spin.configuration.neglectVeilOpaci: How dark the left half of a neglected player's screen gets (0 = no veil, 1 = black): the victim loses sight on the left.
rotp_spin.configuration.neglectVeilFadeW: Share of the screen width, left of the centre line, over which the veil fades into clear sight.
rotp_spin.configuration.neglectVeilFadeO: During the last ticks of the neglect the veil lifts gradually; this is how many ticks that takes.
rotp_spin.configuration.legHeight.toolti: A hit below this share of the target's height lands on the legs.
rotp_spin.configuration.headHeight.toolt: A hit at or above this share of the target's height lands on the head; between the leg zone and this, on the body and arms.
rotp_spin.configuration.limbTicks.toolti: Duration of Slowness / Weakness from a flattened limb, in ticks. A damaged ball multiplies it by its damage multiplier (Steel Ball group).
rotp_spin.configuration.limbAmplifier.to: Amplifier of Slowness / Weakness (0 = level I).
rotp_spin.configuration.dryTicks.tooltip: Duration of Desiccation, in ticks. A damaged ball multiplies it like the limb effect. 0 disables Desiccation.
rotp_spin.configuration.dryExhaustionPer: Extra food exhaustion per tick of Desiccation for players (vanilla sprinting is 0.1 per block). Desiccation also puts out fire.
rotp_spin.configuration.waterMobBonusDam: Extra damage to water creatures (drowned, guardians, squid and other water mobs) when the water is wrung out of them.
Damage bonus per source: the multiplier is 1 + sources x this.
rotp_spin.configuration.maxMultiplier.to: Upper limit of the resonance damage multiplier.
rotp_spin.configuration.maxSources.toolt: At most this many sources count.
rotp_spin.configuration.extraFlightTicks: Extra ticks of forward flight per source before the ball turns back (longer range).
Blocks of free fall before the sail opens; an ordinary jump does not open it.
rotp_spin.configuration.maxFallSpeed.too: Descent speed cap under the sail, in blocks per tick.
rotp_spin.configuration.forwardPush.tool: Horizontal push along the look direction each tick, in blocks per tick.
rotp_spin.configuration.maxHorizontalSpe: Horizontal speed cap under the sail, in blocks per tick.
rotp_spin.configuration.costPerTick.tool: Spin energy spent per tick of sailing; regeneration keeps running meanwhile.
rotp_spin.configuration.startEnergy.tool: Spin energy needed to open the sail (keeping it open needs only the cost per tick), so an exhausted user falls instead of flickering.
rotp_spin.configuration.naturalSpawn.too: On: Gyro Zeppeli wanders the open country on his own, rare and always alone. Off: he does not spawn naturally.
rotp_spin.configuration.spawnWeight.tool: Spawn weight among the creatures of a matching biome; a cow is 8, a horse is 1 to 5. Higher values make Gyro more common.
Biome categories where Gyro spawns naturally. One name per entry: NETHER, THEEND, OCEAN, SAVANNA, MESA, JUNGLE, TAIGA, FOREST, RIVER, BEACH, PLAINS, ICY, DESERT, SWAMP, MUSHROOM, EXTREME_HILLS, UNDERGROUND, NONE.
rotp_spin.configuration.uniqueRadius.too: Gyro is one man: he does not spawn naturally while another Gyro is within this many blocks (only loaded entities are seen; at chunk generation the low weight keeps him rare). 0 turns the check off.
rotp_spin.configuration.minLight.tooltip: Minimum light level for a natural spawn (animals use 9).
rotp_spin.configuration.villageSpawn.too: On: Gyro stops in a town on a race stage: a player inside a village may meet him at its centre, one Gyro per village.
rotp_spin.configuration.villageBiomeCate: Biome categories (at the village centre) of the villages Gyro visits: prairie, savanna and the Arizona desert stage. One name per entry: NETHER, THEEND, OCEAN, SAVANNA, MESA, JUNGLE, TAIGA, FOREST, RIVER, BEACH, PLAINS, ICY, DESERT, SWAMP, MUSHROOM, EXTREME_HILLS, UNDERGROUND, NONE.
rotp_spin.configuration.villageCheckInte: How often each player's village is checked, in ticks. 1200 ticks = 1 minute.
rotp_spin.configuration.villageSpawnChan: Chance (0 to 1) per check that Gyro arrives in a village that has none.
rotp_spin.configuration.villageRadius.to: A Gyro within this many blocks of the village centre counts as the village's Gyro.
rotp_spin.configuration.villageSpawnSpre: Gyro appears up to this many blocks from the village centre.
rotp_spin.configuration.villageSpawnAtte: Spots tried per successful roll before giving up until the next check.
rotp_spin.configuration.spawnWithHorse.t: On: a naturally spawned or village Gyro brings a saddled horse, Valkyrie, on a lead. She is not tamed for anyone. Spawn eggs and commands spawn him alone.
rotp_spin.configuration.horseOffset.tool: How far from Gyro, in blocks, his horse stands.
rotp_spin.configuration.charge4.tooltip: Lesson 4 Golden Spin: spin charge added to Tusk's nails (more damage, and it opens Tusk's own wormhole on break).
rotp_spin.configuration.charge5.tooltip: Lesson 5 Super Spin: spin charge added to Tusk's nails.
rotp_spin.configuration.herbsEnabled.too: On: a Tusk user chewing a herb from the rotp_spin:tusk_nail_herbs tag (mint and chamomile; by default the oxeye daisy) gets a herbal infusion that grows extra nails. Off: herbs do nothing.
rotp_spin.configuration.herbDurationTick: Herbal infusion duration per herb, in ticks. 1200 ticks = 1 minute.
rotp_spin.configuration.herbIntervalTick: While the infusion lasts, one extra nail grows every this many ticks (on top of Tusk's own regrowth).
rotp_spin.configuration.herbMaxStack.too: The infusion can be stacked up to this many herb durations.
rotp_spin.configuration.infiniteRotation: On: a Spin user with Tusk on ACT4 who holds Super Spin (natural gallop or the lesson 5 detour kick) gets Tusk's infinite rotation charge. Tusk's own unlock route stays as it is.
Lowest Spin lesson for the infinite rotation charge and for counter-rotation.
rotp_spin.configuration.counterRotationE: On: a spinning steel ball removes Tusk's infinite rotation from the target it hits. Off: it does not.
rotp_spin.configuration.counterRotationN: On: counter-rotation needs the thrower to hold Super Spin (and an unchipped ball). Off: any lesson-gated spinning ball works.
